fields.statement: QA with a scratch build in a $TMPDIR root: run status --json shows interventions [] and intervention_count 0 for a clean run, the list in journal order and the count for one with interventions, and text '- Interventions: 3 (resume 2, abandon 1)' plus an Interventions list; a hand-appended entry of kind bogus is not counted and run status warns 'unknown kind "bogus": not counted'.

QA with a scratch build: session message from outside any run to a run's session journals one message intervention (actor, session, first line); from a session of the same run (RHIZA_RUN+RHIZA_SESSION or RHIZA_SESSION alone) none; to a session of no run sent, none; dry run and blank text none. Rough edge (minor finding): a message to a finished run's session still journals on that run.

QA with a scratch build: person's queued and foreground resume, resume --retry and abandon each journal the matching intervention with actor and step; dry runs, refused resumes/abandons and RHIZA_DAEMON_RESUME (daemon/watchdog) journal none. Major finding: a person's rhiza run start of a change set with a failed run starts a new run and journals no retry intervention, contrary to the statement.

QA with a scratch build: owner rhiza accept of a change set whose live run has accept auto journals one approve ('accepted change set <id> at step hold'); an accept the run waits on (rhiza.autonomy.accept owner), an accept of a change set whose run is finished, a refused second accept and a refused --rule autonomous journal none.

QA with a scratch build, two-wait workflow: Review: this run, Leaf: of the change set and a merge of main are not counted; plain, Review: other run and unknown Leaf: commits are journalled once each on entering the next step, a later one once at finish, no duplicates, run result unchanged. Major finding: the run's own 'Merge origin/<branch> into <branch>' (ship divergence merge) is counted as a hand commit; minors: a rebase onto main counts main's commits, an Actor: trailer naming the process's owner actor is excused.

QA with a scratch build: daemon status --json and text show finished/finished_clean/clean_streak matching each run's status (9/3/0, then 10/4/1 after a clean newest finish); after rhiza daemon --once with detach faked, live rows carry intervention_count and text ', N interventions'; a fresh project shows 0/0/0 without error.
